bcmer_1_71_weight_path_analysis.version_proof: BrutalCompanyMinus/Plugin.cs declares VERSION = 1.71.0 at the exact upstream commit
bcmer_1_71_weight_path_analysis.principal_type_dependent_factor: eventTypeCount[i], the number of enabled events in EventManager.events for that EventType
bcmer_1_71_weight_path_analysis.semantic_correction: The logged Set eventType weight value is a per-event weight assigned to every event of that type, not the aggregate EventType mass.
bcmer_1_71_weight_path_analysis.equal_scale_result: With eight constant 12.5 scales, BCMER computes eventTypeProbabilities[i] = 0.125 for every type and uses inverse event-count normalization to distribute that type mass across individual events.
bcmer_1_71_weight_path_analysis.superseded_rejection_interpretation: Requiring all eight logged per-event weights to be identical was an invalid acceptance gate for EventType equality.
bcmer_1_71_weight_path_analysis.implementation_decision: Do not apply inverse config compensation and do not force equal per-event weights with a project-local patch. No new successor implementation is justified by this analysis; the existing equal-scale S1.42AC concept is the correct static EventType-probability approach under BCMER ownership.
bcmer_1_71_weight_path_analysis.promotion_status: S1.42AC remains formally rejected/not accepted until an explicit corrected acceptance interpretation is applied. This analysis does not silently promote it.
